questions.question: If x = 7 + 2√10, then what is the value of √x – 1/√x?

Which of the following relation(s) is/are true?

I. √7 + √3 > √5 + √5

II. √5 + √5 > √2 + √8

III. √5 + √5 > √7 + √3
If a = 1 + √3, b = 1 – √3, then what is the value of a² + b²?
What is the unit’s place of 12¹²³?
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Unit digit: It is defined as the digit at once place of a given number. To calculate the unit digit, of a certain number with some power or product of numbers, we only have to focus on the digit at the one place of numbers.

**Cyclicity**: The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number. The cyclicity of any number is about the last digit and how they appear in a certain defined manner.

**Procedure to find unit digit:**

Step-1: Take the given power like the power of the unit digit of a given number.

Step-2: Divide the power by cyclicity of a given number

If it is completely divisible, then the unit digit will be digit at once place to the power its cyclicity.

If it is not divisible completely, replace the power with the remainder obtained, let xy (where x is a unit digit of a given number and y is remainder).

Step-3: Now, the unit digit will be obtained by simplifying xy.

**Calculation:**

12¹²³

Unit digit of the given number (base) is 3, and its cyclicity 4. Hence,

Step-1 123/4 ⇒ Remainder = 3

Step-2 (2)³ = 8

Unit digit of 12123 will be 8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

The last digit series of powers of 12 is 2, 4, 8, 6, 2.

∴ Numbers of form 12⁴k ⁺ ¹ : 2

∴ Numbers of form 12⁴k ⁺ ² : 4

∴ Numbers of form 12⁴k ⁺ ³ : 8

∴ Numbers of form 12⁴k ⁺ ⁴ : 6

∴ 12¹²³ = 12⁴ × ³⁰ ⁺ ³ will have 8 as unit digit.

questions.question: How many two-digit numbers are divisible by 3 but not by 7?
questions.solution:
Number of 2-digit numbers : 10 – 99 = 90

Numbers divisible by 3: 12, 15, ..., 99 = 30 Numbers

Numbers divisible by 3 and 7: 21, 42, 63, 84 = 4 Numbers

Numbers divisible by 3 but not 7: 30 – 4 = 26 Numbers

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 hours and Pipe B can fill the tank in 18 hours. If both the pipes are opened on alternate hours and if pipe B is opened first, then in how much time (in hours) the tank will be full?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to fill the tank = 12 hours 

Time taken by B to fill the tank = 18 hours 

**Concept used:**

Total capacity = LCM 

Efficiency = (Total Capacity)/(Total time)

**Calculations:**

Efficiency of pipe A = 1/12

Efficiency of pipe B = 1/18

If both opened together, work done in 2 hours = 1/18 + 1/12 = 5/36

So, 2 hour work = 5/36

After 14 hours (2 × 7), work done = 7 × 5/36 = 35/36.

Work left = 1 – 35/36 = 1/36.

Remaining work will be done by pipe B in h hours.

⇒ h/18 = 1/36

⇒ h = 1/2

Total time = 14 + 1/2 = 14.5 hours

**∴ The total time is 14.5 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ac65152a60d945c6d3083091239337d6d3aec75013364c8cc4aaf65a8db8a85.png]

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 20, 24 and 30 days respectively. All three of them began the work together but B left 3 days before completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?
questions.solution:
Let the work took n days to complete.

⇒ A and C worked for n days

⇒ B worked for n – 3 days

Total work done = n × (1/20 + 1/30) + (n – 3) × (1/24) = n × (1/20 + 1/30 + 1/24) – 3/24 = 1

⇒ n × (6 + 4 + 5)/120 – 15/120 = (15n – 15)/120 = (n – 1)/8 = 1

⇒ n = 9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

A, B and C can do a piece of work in 20, 24 and 30 days

LCM of 20, 24 and 30 

⇒ 120 unit total work

⇒ Efficiency of A = 6 unit

⇒ Efficiency of B = 5 unit

⇒ Efficiency of C = 4 unit

B left 3 days before

⇒ 3 × 5 = 15 unit

Total work = 120 + 15 = 135 unit

Together complete in 6 + 5 + 4 = 15 unit

⇒ 135/15 

⇒ 9 days

**∴ The work completed was 9 days.**

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs 8480. If a discount of 12.5% is given, then what will be the selling price (in Rs) of the article?
An item is sold for Rs 1428 after two successive discounts of 12.5% and 20%. What is the marked price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
Let the marked price me m.

Price after first discount: m – 12.5% = m – m/8 = 7m/8.

Price after second discount: 7m/8 – 20% = 7m/8 – 7m/40 = 28m/40 = 7m/10 = 1428

⇒ m = Rs 2040

A started a business with Rs. 20000 and B joined after some time with Rs. 25000. If A and B share the profit in the ratio of 1 : 2 respectively, then what is the ratio of the time period of investment for A and B respectively?
questions.solution:
Amount invested by A = p = Rs 20000

Amount invested by B = q = Rs 25000

Let the time after of investment of A be x.

Let the time after of investment of B be y.

Ratio of share = (p/q) × (x/y) = 1/2

⇒ p/q = (1/2) × (y/x) = (1/2) × (25/20) = 5/8

questions.question: The average of 6 consecutive even numbers is 25. If the next even number is also considered, then what is the new average?
questions.solution:
Let the first integer be 2x.

Average of 6 consecutive integers:

(2x + (2x + 2) + ... + (2x + 10))/6 = 12x + 2(1 + 2 + ... + 5)

= 12x + 30 = 25 × 6 = 150

⇒ x = 10.

Average of new numbers:

(2x + (2x + 2) + ... + (2x + 12) )/ 7

= (14x + 42)/7

= 2x + 6

= 20 + 6

= 26.

questions.question: There is group of 8 teachers. One teacher leaves the group and a new teacher joins the group. Due to this, the average age of teachers becomes same as the average 2 years ago. If the member who left was aged 42. Then what is the age (in years) of new teacher?
questions.solution:
Let the sum of present ages of teachers be S.

Let the age of new teacher be n.

New average = old average 2 years ago = (S – 2 × 8)/8 = (S – 42 + n)/8

Solving, we get

S – 16 = S – 42 + n

⇒ n = 26

questions.question: A purchased an article and sold it to B at a loss of 20% and B sold it to C at a gain of 20%. C purchases the article for Rs 480. For what price (in Rs) A has purchased the article?
questions.solution:
**Short trick:**

Required price = 480/(0.8 × 1.2) = Rs. 500

**Detailed solution:**

Let the initial cost price of the product be x.

Selling price for A: SP = CP – Loss = x – 20% = 4x/5

Selling price for B: SP = CP + Profit = 4x/5 + 20% = 24x/25 = 480

⇒ x = 480 × 25/24 = Rs. 500.

questions.question: 20% of the cost price is equal to 30% of the selling price. What is the loss percentage?
questions.solution:
Let Cost Price be c.

Let Selling Price be s.

20% Cost Price = 30% Selling Price

⇒ c/5 = 3s/10

⇒ c/s = 3/2

Loss% = 100 × (CP - SP)/CP = 100 × (c - s)/c = 100 × (1 - s/c) = 100 × (1 - 2/3) = 100/3 = 33.33%

questions.question: Salary of A is 20% more than B and salary of B is 18% more than C. The salary of C is (approximately) how much percent less than A?
questions.solution:
Let salary of C be x.

⇒ Salary of B = x + 18% = x + 18% = x + 18x/100 = 118x/100 = 59x/50

⇒ Salary of A = 59x/50 + 20% = 177x/125

Difference of salaries of A and C: 177x/125 – x = 52x/125

% Difference = 100 × (52x/125)/(177x/125) = 100 × 52/177 = 29.37 ~ 29.4%

questions.solution:

The ratio of speed is inversely proportional to the ratio of time taken 

⇒ the ratio of speed = 80 : 60 = 4 : 3

⇒ The ratio of time taken = 3 : 4

4 units - 3 units = 15 + 15 = 30 minutes

⇒ 1 units = 30 minutes

Total distance = 90/60 × 80 = 120 km

Actual time taken = 90 + 15 = 105 min

∴ Actual speed = 120 × 60/105 = 480/7

questions.question: One third of a certain journey is covered at the speed of 80 km/hr, one fourth of the journey at the speed of 50 km/hr and the rest at the speed of 100 km/hr. what will be the average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
Let the distance travelled be d.

Time taken in first case: d/s = (d/3)/80 = d/240

Time taken in second case: d/s = (d/4)/50 = d/200

Time taken in third case: d/s = (d – d/4 – d/3)/100 = (5d/12)/100 = d/240

Average Speed = total distance/total time = d/(d/240 + d/200 + d/240) = 1/(1/40 ( 1/6 + 1/5 + 1/6) ) = (1200/16) = 75 km/hr.

questions.question: Three circles of radius 9 cm are kept touching each other. The string is tightly tied around the three circles. What is the length (in cm) of the string?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a8381f56489eab7cc2d373bfc02e936a31306992c57d06e4364af32e20651c5.png]

Total length = 54 + 18π.

questions.question: The difference between circumference and the radius of a circle is 111 cm. What is the area (in cm²) of the circle?

⇒ r = 111 × 7/37 = 21 cm

Area = πr² = 22/7 × 21 × 21 = 1386 cm²

questions.question: If 3x² – 9x + 3 = 0, then what is the value of (x + 1/x)³?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

3x² – 9x + 3 = 0 and we have to find the value of (x + 1/x)³

**Calculation:**

3x2 – 9x + 3 = 0

⇒ x² - 3x + 1 = 0

⇒ x - 3 + 1/x = 0 [Dividing both sides by x]

⇒ x + 1/x = 3

Now,

(x + 1/x)³ = (3)³ = 27

**∴ The required value of (x + 1/x)³ is 27.**

questions.question: If x - 1/x = 3, then what is the value of x³ – 1/x³?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x – 1/x = 3

**Calculation:**

Squaring it, we get

(x – 1/x)² = 9

⇒ x² + 1/x² – 2 = 9

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 1 = 12

⇒ x³ – 1/x³ = (x – 1/x) (x² + 1/x² + 1)

= 3 × 12

= **36**

questions.question: A, B and C are the three points on a circle such that ∠ABC = 35° and ∠BAC = 85°. What is the angle (in degrees) subtended by arc AB at the centre of the circle?

questions.question: What is the value of (cos x + cos y)/(sin x + sin y)?
questions.solution:
Sin x + sin y = 2sin [(x + y)/2] cos [(x – y)/2]

Cos x + cos y = 2cos [(x + y)/2] cos [(x – y)/2]

(cos x + cos y)/ (sin x + sin y) = cot [(x + y)/2] (cos x/sin x = cot x)
